title: Running-app guard: cover the Windows Squirrel install and Windows process killers
notes: running-app-guard.ts matches only .local/opt/dashboard and /Applications/Dashboard.app (INSTALLED line 49, RUNNING_APP line 43) and only pkill/killall/kill. On Windows an agent's rm -rf "$LOCALAPPDATA/Dashboard", taskkill /IM Dashboard.exe /F or Stop-Process -Name Dashboard goes through and kills or deletes the installed app mid-turn (workflow-rule-1). Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/326 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/325#discussion_r4612730992
